find_unique_values: find unique values in a numpy array with optional inverse indices and counts
encode_values_to_integers: encode categorical values into integer labels from 0 to n_uniques minus 1
check_unknown_labels: check for unknown labels in values that are not present in known values
extract_missing_values: extract missing values (None and NaN) from a set of values
get_value_counts: get the count of each unique value in an array using a specified order
